notes: A portal’s default name is a real one: a second Omen is “Omen 2” (then 3 …), in the tray, the right-click, the Control Panel and the notices, instead of “New Panel”.
A saved portal still named “New Panel” is renamed at start (to “Omen 2” and so on); a name you chose is kept. The window title stays “Sigil — Omen”.
